items.desc: Iran security chief discusses US-Israel war with Russian president: state media Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei has spoken with Russian President Vladimir Putin about the US-Israel war on the country. "As part of high-level consultations between Iran and Russia, and following recent meetings between senior officials of the two countries, General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, and Russian President Vladimir Putin discussed the current situation... in the Middle East during a telephone conversation," the state-run IRNA news agency said.

items.desc: Iran's supreme leader gave government 'certain authorities' over talks, president says Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian said the country's supreme leader has granted "certain authorities" to the government in regards to peace talks, state media reported on Monday. Pezeshkian said Tehran "will try to resolve the problem with dialogue", without elaborating, according to state media. Reporting by Reuters

items.title: Iran says ready to reopen Hormuz in two days if US agrees to demands
items.desc: Iran says ready to reopen Hormuz in two days if US agrees to demands Iran on Monday said it was ready to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if Washington agrees to its conditions, as US President Donald Trump issued his latest war threat at a rally for the upcoming US midterm elections. A senior Iranian official said the offer to open the vital energy corridor, which follows intense efforts by mediators to stop a return to war, showed "good faith". Tehran has blockaded Hormuz since the war started in February, sending energy prices soaring and posing an electoral challenge for Trump.
